subject.title: fix(agent-core): bound harness exec stdout/stderr at 16 MiB

question: Should `NodeExecutionEnv.exec` truncate captured stdout and stderr at 16 MiB per stream by default, with `maxOutputBytes` as the opt-up path for large-output callers?
rationale: The implementation fixes a real availability risk, but it changes the public `@openclaw/agent-core` shell execution return contract for existing large-output consumers, which automation should not decide by policy alone.

options.title: Accept bounded capture as the new contract
options.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported opt-up for callers that intentionally need more captured output.

options.title: Require explicit large-output compatibility proof
options.body: Ask for a focused note or test showing existing harness consumers can raise `maxOutputBytes` before accepting the default cap.

options.title: Redesign default behavior
options.body: Pause this PR if full unbounded capture is still considered the current harness contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded capture as the new contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported opt-up for callers that intentionally need more captured output.

likelyOwner.reason: The current harness files and adjacent 16 MiB process-exec cap both route most clearly through this person's recent history.
